title: Astir Events — one event link, state-dependent destination
status: Product decision model for design and engineering; not implemented routing code or passed tests

session.meaning: Only valid_recognized supplies a trusted current identity

reservation_lookup.meaning: Only a successful lookup for the trusted current identity can classify the real booking

booking.meaning: unknown is not none; none means verified lookup found no active booking for this current identity

event_access.meaning: The actual event visibility policy, including unpublished/not-found handling

phase.meaning: Event time and configured state, not the timestamp of the link

admission.meaning: Authenticated event-specific server record; RSVP or self-report is insufficient

checkin_completion.meaning: Historical event-specific completion remains completed after personal post deletion

invariants.rule: All View event links resolve the same event and then evaluate the current viewer state. A forwarded reminder grants no recipient privileges.

Unknown, expired, recovering, or failed identity/lookup is never displayed as confirmed not-RSVPed. Show neutral event content and identity recovery; do not create another RSVP until identity and its existing booking are resolved.
App Clip and browser mimic the event-specific in-app experience, without full-app tabs. Account, booking, code, event, and return context survive surface handoff.
A recognized confirmed RSVP can view the full guest list and View or change RSVP in App Clip/web. Download remains optional until an app-only action.
Full-app installation, a valid confirmed booking, and valid name plus username are required for the entry QR/entry. Photo remains optional.

No-app post-event check-in and upload actions require opening/installing Astir, then recovering the same identity/event and rechecking eligibility. Uninstall/reinstall does not erase the server booking, attendance, or completion.

Recap access requires valid admission plus historical completion for this event; gallery upload additionally occurs in the full app. A personal post, another event, RSVP or self-report never substitutes.
Every event has one canonical place. Address permission, map visibility, full guest list, public post audience, and protected recap are independent.
Optional codes and code-use limits never override account verification, capacity, approval, offer acceptance, or installed-entry requirements.
